ignored-command-toggle-side-effects.json.topic: type107 show-name and type8 effect/snow side effects
ignored-command-toggle-side-effects.json.basis: Primary Ref source plus current src port inspection; static only; no executable run and no code edits.

showname_type107.primary_action: Ref/GameMode.cpp:17085-17093 (ProcessTalkType 0x578f10): toggle g_session.m_isShowNameTypeOld using old==0; call CSession::SetTextType(&g_session,new,new); send UIWindowMgr message3; choose MSI_SHOWNAME_ON when new value true else MSI_SHOWNAME_OFF; shared LABEL_513 sends notice message1 in color 6619135; return. No actor/name balloon invalidation or rebuild call occurs in this case.
showname_type107.SetTextType: Ref/Locale.cpp:227-239, address 0x503a70: only when service is Korea, Indonesia, Germany, or Brazil, assign global NameBalloonShorten=isShorten and NameBalloonfontBold=isBold. Both arguments from type107 are the same new bool. Other service types leave those globals untouched.
showname_type107.consumers: Ref/UIControl.cpp: UINameBalloonText name-string/layout paths check NameBalloonShorten (e.g. 7777 and 8049); text width/height calls use NameBalloonfontBold (e.g. 7802-7820, 7893 onward). Ref/Locale.cpp:841-849 initializes these globals by locale: Korea/Indonesia sets shorten+bold=1 and font size13; other branch sets both0 and size12. These globals affect name balloon shortening/layout/font weight. The toggle itself does not explicitly invalidate current balloons; whether already-built balloon strings/heights immediately reflow is not established by this case alone.
showname_type107.port_status: Current src has m_isShowNameTypeOld defaulted and includes it in source command flag-table data (src/session/Session.h:180; src/session/Session.cpp:3469-3473), but no SetTextType, NameBalloonShorten/NameBalloonfontBold, or UINameBalloonText equivalent was found under src. Current actor-name drawing references are hover/locked-target labels in src/gamemode/GameMode.cpp:3512,3568 and do not reference this flag. Therefore port state exists, but this primary name-balloon behavior/consumer integration is absent.

effect8_xmas_snow.primary_order: Ref/GameMode.cpp:16059-16090: compute new effect state as 1-old, assign g_session.m_isEffectOn, then if map name exactly matches XmasFild01.rsw or Xmas.rsw, call LaunchSnow when new state true and StopSnow when false. After weather call: manager message3; on/off notice message1 at color6619135; construct opcode541 value0 for on or1 for off; send packet via common LABEL_155 path. Snow helper executes before UI update/notice/packet.
effect8_xmas_snow.weather_helpers: Ref/RagEffectPrim.cpp:6480-6496 (LaunchSnow, 0x649ab0) only relaunches if current effect is absent or remaining duration<=300; obtains current game-world player, stores it in m_pPlayer, and launches effect type162 at zero vector offset and scale0. Ref/RagEffectPrim.cpp:6684-6691 (StopSnow, 0x649b30) if effect exists, sets its duration to current state count+300, allowing it to wind down. Ref/RagEffectPrim.cpp:6498 onward Process clears stale m_Effect when effect no longer exists.
effect8_xmas_snow.snow_emitter_match: Primary Ref/RagEffect.cpp:7767-7813, CRagEffect::Snow at0x5f7520; current src/world/RagEffect.cpp:16555-16588, CRagEffect::SpawnSnow. The port emitter is a direct structural match: update position to player; only emit while remaining duration>160; two particle prims; duration320; rotate/random offset, height-100, speed-0.5, alpha/fade and snow sprite/action resources. Port comment identifies the same source function. Thus the low-level snow emitter exists and matches; the separate CWeather manager that tracks one effect/player, launches type162 with the >300 restart threshold, and shortens duration on stop was not found in src.
effect8_xmas_snow.port_status: Current src implements effect gating in multiple rendering/packet paths (e.g. src/gamemode/GameMode.cpp:451; src/world/World.cpp:1773; src/gamemode/GameModePacket.cpp:750), and the snow emitter, but no type8 ProcessTalkType action, Xmas map check, CWeather::LaunchSnow/StopSnow wrapper, or opcode541 toggle path was found in src. The manager-level command side effects remain missing despite emitter support.
unknowns: No claim that toggling showname reflows already-instantiated balloons immediately; the primary toggle has no explicit invalidation/rebuild call, and constructor/update timing was not fully resolved here.

The exact current-port equivalent owner for storing snow-effect/player handles is absent from the searched source; don't substitute direct emitter spawning for the primary weather-manager lifecycle without integration work.

ignored-command-toggle-audio-options.jso.scope: Read-only source comparison for type 7 BGM and type 11 sound toggles, option-window message 60, and port audio effects. No runtime execution.

type7.operation: Invert g_session.m_bgmIsPaused. If the new value is true, call CloseStream(); otherwise call PlayStream(streamFileName). Send window-manager message 3, choose BGM_OFF when paused or BGM_ON otherwise, then take LABEL_279.
type7.option_refresh: LABEL_279 sends notice; LABEL_280 (lines 17108-17113) sends m_optionWnd->UIWindow::SendMsg(sender=null,message=60,...) if the option window exists.

type11.operation: Invert g_isSoundOn; choose MSI_SOUND_ON when true or MSI_SOUND_OFF when false; goto LABEL_279. The case itself does not change g_soundMode and does not call EndDigitalSound.
type11.option_refresh: Uses the same LABEL_279/LABEL_280 path described for type 7, so an open option window receives message 60.

option_message60.effect: Read-only refresh from source globals: m_bgmVolume <- g_session.m_BgmVolume; m_soundVolume <- Get2DVolume(); scrollbar positions <- those values; checkbox state <- !g_session.m_bgmIsPaused, g_isSoundOn, monster snap fields, and g_session.m_isNoCtrl; invalidate window.
option_message60.persistence: This message-60 branch does not call SaveInfo, registry/INI writes, or audio setters. It synchronizes controls to source state rather than writing source fields.

option_message.effect: UIOptionWnd::SendMsg returns 0 when msg != 6 or sender is null. Thus the source-style manager call with null sender and message 60 is currently a no-op; it does not refresh controls, apply audio, or save settings.

apply_audio.effect: ApplyAudioSettings writes g_soundMode and g_isSoundOn from m_soundEnabled, sets CAudio sound volume and BGM volume, and sets BGM pause from m_bgmEnabled. Audio sliders and audio checkbox paths call this method; it is not gated by source command state.

save_audio_settings.effect: SaveSettings persists m_bgmVolume, m_soundVolume, m_bgmEnabled and m_soundEnabled to the Option INI section. It runs on window close / drag completion and after checkbox message 6. Message 60 itself does not reach SaveSettings because of the early guard.
save_audio_settings.consequence: If a command toggles a global while the option window is open, its in-memory audio controls remain stale. Closing can persist those stale values to INI. A later ApplyAudioSettings (for example, moving an audio slider or changing either audio checkbox) can also replace both g_soundMode/g_isSoundOn and the BGM pause state from those stale controls. This overwrite is not performed by message 60 itself.

bgm_runtime.effect: CAudio stores m_bgmPaused; SetBgmPaused updates the stored value and forwards to an initialized backend. Later PlayBGM passes that paused value to the backend. This path does not call CloseStream/PlayStream.

bgm_backends.effect: SetBgmPaused forwards pause to the stream. On unpause after a pending start, it starts the stream before forwarding unpause.
SetBgmPaused stops the current sound when paused; when unpaused, starts it if it is not playing.

sound_runtime.effect: CAudio::PlaySound and the PlayWave path are gated by both g_soundMode and g_isSoundOn. PlayWave uses mode 2 for 3D-provider/relative playback and mode 1 for the 2D-volume path; other nonzero modes return false there. UIOptionWnd::ApplyAudioSettings maps sound-enabled to mode 1 and also assigns g_isSoundOn. Type 11's original behavior only flips g_isSoundOn, which suppresses subsequent gated wave playback; this switch does not itself stop all currently active sounds.

startup_audio_settings.effect: Saved audio settings initialize UI member values and ApplySavedAudioSettings applies them. On UI creation, ApplyAudioSettings is called. UIWindowMgr initializes source command flags from CAudio::IsBgmPaused() and g_isSoundOn.

ignored-command-toggle-audio-options.jso.review_note: Original option message 60 refreshes controls from current globals and does not save or mutate those globals. Port message 60 currently does nothing. The possible stale-control overwrite is through later port ApplyAudioSettings or persistence of stale member values, not through message-60 handling.
